Repair and extend the Eywa offline campaign toolkit in `/workspace/project`.
It must compile typed model layouts, recover symbolic tests, and prepare replay.
Work inside the supplied Python package; the current pipeline is incomplete.
The type visitors, expression AST, graph composer, and runner need integration.
Read `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md` for every input, output, and semantic boundary.
Repair aggregate numbering and strict test decoding across nested named types.
Support scoped validation, exact arithmetic, and deterministic state preambles.
Model-return values are witnesses; they do not define the identity of a test.
Deliver the complete project tree, including `campaign_cli.py` and `src/`.
All regular auxiliary files are allowed within the published submission bounds.
The evaluator runs `python3 -I -B /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py`.
The program reads one JSON campaign and writes its complete JSON certificate.
No network calls, model service, Docker daemon, or symbolic engine is required.
Python 3.11.14 and its standard library provide all required dependencies.
Develop with `python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < /workspace/examples/smoke.input.json`.
Run `python3 /workspace/public_check.py /workspace/project` for public sanity.
The public check does not cover the full documented domain or maximum scale.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
The implementation is complete and fully verified. Final summary of the delivered project:

**`/workspace/project`** (18 entries, 0.14 MiB — well inside submission bounds):

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `campaign_cli.py` | strict JSON framing (`{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}` for dup keys / nonfinite / bad UTF‑8 / trailing JSON / >64 MiB), streams one certificate, always exit 0 |
| `src/eywa/ast.py` | typed model types with transparent aliases; full predicate AST (`var,const,field,index,all,match,not,eq…implies`); repaired `Forall` with **lexical binding scoping**; scope-stack `Evaluator`; closure compiler (compile once, replay per record); constant folding |
| `src/eywa/oracles.py` | `MainBuilder` numbering convention; **repaired aggregate numbering** in `HarnessLayout` (composites reserve an ID but own no object, `String(N)` → buffer + N char objects, aliases reserve nothing, zero-length composites reserve, void reserves none); slots/paths/widths; **strict inverse reader** (never skips to a nearby `xN`); cursor value assembly with NUL truncation |
| `src/eywa/composer.py` | deduped dependency graph, root-scoped `compile_order` (Kahn + lexicographically smallest eligible) |
| `src/eywa/regex.py` | full campaign pattern grammar parser; Thompson NFA with Latin‑1 bit masks, lazy memoised ε-closures, lazy DFA cache → linear matching, no catastrophic backtracking |
| `src/eywa/wire.py` | strict KTEST v3 decoder (BE framing, opaque ignored arguments, no trailing byte, duplicate/unknown detection) |
| `src/eywa/run.py` | corpus identity preserving JSON type identity (bool ≠ int, `[]` ≠ `{}`), first-usable-run indices, ordered witnesses |
| `src/eywa/state.py` | exact `(cost, commands, lexicographic)` preparation: Dijkstra + cost-tight subgraph + reverse BFS + greedy lex walk, cached per enabled-mask |
| `src/eywa/offline.py` | pipeline: compile → plan → recover → flag attestation → filtering → reachability → dedup |
| `tests/` | 27-test regression suite plus an independent KTEST fixture writer |

**Validation performed:** both public fixtures byte-exact; 27 unit tests; 8 integration suites (nested/aliased/zero-length types, deep 58-level nesting, transitive & diamond pipes, helper-local pipes, multi-param binds, void results, `String(0)`/`String(512)`, 4096-value enums, uint64 exactness, all predicate forms, all transport/inventory/leaf error classes, flag precedence, state ties & cycles); 9000-case regex fuzz vs an independent `re` oracle (0 mismatches); 5500-case preparation fuzz vs brute force (0 mismatches); near-max scale (45.8 MiB input, 2.13 M objects, 2048 runs, 32 entries, 4096 modules, 16 k edges, 4096 states, 16 k transitions) in **6.3 s / 214 MiB**, and a 1024-run distinct-guard-mask worst case in 12.8 s — both far inside the 120 s budget.
